Carlos Grande — personal knowledge site

Canonical site URL: https://carlosgrande.me/docs/
Primary language: English. Spanish translations are also available for selected pages under https://carlosgrande.me/docs/es/.

This site is Carlos Grande's personal life cheat sheet: a collection of projects, articles, notebooks, and practical resources about coding, data architecture, data science, visualization, business, and AI. Carlos Grande describes himself as a Data Engineer, Architect, and coding enthusiast.

Main sections

Home
https://carlosgrande.me/docs/
The homepage introduces the site and presents its published content.

Notebooks
https://carlosgrande.me/docs/notebooks/
Technical notes organized by Coding, Data science, Data Architecture, and Business.

Projects
https://carlosgrande.me/docs/projects/
Personal projects, including PicKasa, Madrid Airbnb Analysis, Madrid Invisible, and a Rubik's Cube model.

References
https://carlosgrande.me/docs/references/
Curated Articles and Case studies related to technology, data, design, and visualization.

Resources
https://carlosgrande.me/docs/resources/
Practical materials grouped as thesis articles, cheat sheets, coding templates, and favorite tools.

About me
https://carlosgrande.me/docs/about-me/
Background about Carlos Grande and links to his public profiles.
